# Gramlot 0.3.37

## Data and structure by address only

- Components reference data and structure only by address in the page Data or Source, never by holding a Bag or a node. Only the root Data and the Source root are held; the data Bag is never replaced. A Bag without a parent may be held; a Bag with a parent is passed by path. Recorded in the constitution.
- `node._internal` holds non-reactive per-node state; author-visible component state lives in `#WORKSPACE`.
- The legacy symbolic paths resolve with the same cases in Python and JavaScript: `#ROW` (also in grid `edit` options), `#WORKSPACE`, `#DATA`, `#FORM`, `#ANCHOR`, `#<nodeId>` (whole page), `#parent`, `?attr` (at most one), named children.
- dataBinder `connection` and named connections on `gramlot.rpc` (`MessagePortConnection`, `MessagePortStore`). The inspector reads its copies of the page through a connection.

## API changes

- `mountIndexPage({state})` takes the Data path of its state.
- `setTreeStore` is removed: a tree reads its store at `storepath`. The check lists (`checkedPaths`, `checked_<attribute>`) are the only source of tree checks.
- Attributes whose name starts with `_dv_` are derived values and never make an editing session modified. The choice caption is `_dv_displayedValue` (was `_displayedValue`).
- Grid `edit` options accept a Bag only without a parent; X parameters bound to a Bag with a parent are projected as null and read by address.

## Removed

- The Vizabi bubble trial (collection `vizabi`, component `vizabiBubble`, public page 485).

## Inspector

- Undo and Redo are disabled while a command is in flight; the styles tab loads on a connection that is still starting.
